svg.title: FlashRSI — A unified framework for agent self-improvement
svg.desc: Hand-drawn architecture diagram, with algorithm families, immutable native-resource snapshots, an external editing policy, harness-specific adapters, and six benchmark categories. Every native file remains present; evolution scope limits the editing view.
svg.text: Full resources execute; scope limits the editing view
Each harness binds its own snapshot
Train / dev for evolution · frozen snapshots for test / transfer
